title_youtube: Your Fingers Have No Muscles (So What Moves Them?)
description_youtube:
Do your fingers have muscles? Not a single one that moves them.

Your fingers contain bones, tendons, ligaments, nerves and blood vessels, but no muscles that move them (the only muscle cells in there are tiny ones that raise the hairs). Every bend and wiggle is powered by muscles in your forearm and your palm, which pull on long tendons running through your wrist into your fingers, like strings on a puppet.

Try it: put your arm on a table, wiggle your fingers and watch your forearm move. 👇 Did you see it?

Sources:
- Wikipedia, Finger (anatomy: fingers do not contain muscles other than arrector pili; the muscles that move them are in the palm and forearm): https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Finger
- Today I Found Out, Fingers Don't Contain Muscles: https://www.todayifoundout.com/?p=14585
- OrthoTree, Normal Hand Anatomy: https://www.orthotree.com/normal-hand-anatomy.html
